timeline.event: Profile-db connection pool spikes to 99% (db_metrics.json), oncall notices spike after flag enable (chat_notes.md)
First 'upstream_profile_timeout' errors appear (18 count) in checkout (alerts.log)
Checkout error rate back to baseline after rollback (alerts.log)

root_cause: The 'checkout_profile_enrichment' feature flag introduced an N+1 query pattern that overwhelmed the profile-db connection pool, causing timeouts in the checkout service.
ruled_out: Network issues (packet loss 0.1%, latency 12ms, DBA confirmed no network anomaly)
Payment gateway failure (status was 'healthy' in db_metrics.json)
evidence_refs: alerts.log: Feature flag enabled at 01:02, followed by timeout errors at 01:04-01:06, rollback at 01:08, recovery at 01:10
db_metrics.json: Profile-db connection pool spiked from 72% to 99% at 01:03, remained at 99% at 01:05
chat_notes.md: DBA analysis points to N+1 query path triggered by checkout_profile_enrichment
